name: handoff
description: Attach to and checkpoint shared agent-session context, per project.

args: for d in "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node"/*/bin "$HOME/.fnm/node-versions"/*/installation/bin "$HOME/.asdf/installs/nodejs"/*/bin /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.volta/bin"; do [ -x "$d/node" ] && exec "$d/node" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/mcp-server/index.js"; done; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec node "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/mcp-server/index.js"; echo 'handoff: node not found on PATH or in common install locations' >&2; exit 127
